name: STACO
source: STACO Insurance Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2020, consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (printed page 48, file _ngx_pdf/STACO.pdf) and the five year financial summary - company (printed page 124). Every period is the separate (company) series, because the report prints the consolidated 2020 column as nil (the group column is dashes for every 2020 line), so a group series would cover only four of the five years. The filed labels are gross premiums written, net insurance premium earned, net fees and commission income, net benefits and claims, total underwriting profit, investment and other income, other expenses, finance costs, loss before taxation, taxation and loss after taxation: Revenue carries net insurance premium earned plus net fees and commission income (the printed net underwriting income), Cost of Sales carries net benefits and claims, and Gross Profit carries the printed total underwriting profit. Filing in NGN thousands, stored here in absolute NGN. CRON 20260929_183159: the previous stored Revenue, Profit Before Tax, Income Tax and Net Profit in this file bore no relation to any figure printed in STACO's audited statements (they did not match the group column, the company column or the five year summary) and have been replaced with the printed figures; both identity chains tie on every period, revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, gross profit plus investment and other income less operating expenses equals EBIT, EBIT plus net finance costs equals loss before taxation, and loss before taxation less taxation equals loss after taxation. Loss per share is printed in kobo and is stored in naira. FY2018 to FY2016 Net Finance Costs are not printed as a separate line in the five year summary (they sit inside other expenses) and are left empty rather than split by assumption.
